disposition_reason: The source orders fits within fixed models and representations and reports best of 10 reproducibility. Exact numeric baseline and historical objective/selection are not recovered: HMM free energy and DyNeMo final sampled training loss require different provenance. Age-effect significance and map similarity are not paper-win metrics; the held-person likelihood extension changes the original task.

source_paper.title: osl-dynamics, a toolbox for modeling fast dynamic brain activity

evidence.supports: Original datasets, group-level fitting, best of 10 source free-energy ordering and reproducibility; young/old analysis is illustrative.
CTF TDE-HMM preparation, model/state capacity, group summaries and apparent inverted age plotting labels.
CTF TDE-DyNeMo source preparation and mode capacity; distinct objective/model from HMM.

evidence.locator: Six-branch original programme and separate held-person extension; SOURCE_CORRECTIONS.md: Native DyNeMo selection
evidence.supports: Full CTF/Elekta original coverage, different historical revision and separately authored holdout objectives remain unqualified.

target.description: Fit source latent-state/network descriptions and assess their reproducibility under unchanged model hyperparameters; free-energy optimization is the potential ordered source route.

dataset.description: CTF resting MEG and Elekta visual-task MEG used in the original paper. Payloads were not read.

cohort.description: CTF 65 healthy participants; Elekta 19 participants with six runs each.

split.description: Original group models use concatenated participant data. A new held-person partition is an extension, not the published fitting comparison.

inputs.description: Source-reconstructed regional MEG time series; original static, burst and network branches retain distinct inputs.

preprocessing.description: Reviewed CTF code uses 250 Hz data, 15 time embeddings, 80 PCA components, standardization, 8 HMM states or 7 DyNeMo modes. Historical cded3b2 versus registered 064104d recipe correspondence remains unqualified.

metric.description: Paper describes variational free energy for fixed-hyperparameter fit ordering. Historical HMM free energy differs from DyNeMo final sampled training-epoch loss; exact criterion, branch normalization and reported values are not recovered.

aggregation.description: Paper describes best of 10 selection and three independent sets. Historical HMM free energy and DyNeMo final history[loss][-1] are distinct criteria; post-fit free_energy() cannot recover the sampled final training trajectory. Exact original selection/aggregation remains unresolved.

comparison.primary_metric: Original within-branch fit-selection statistic: HMM free energy or DyNeMo final training loss; exact source parity unresolved

published_baseline.description: Supplementary free-energy plots show source run selection, but authenticated branch-specific numbers and exact score normalization have not been recovered.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author pipeline routes exist; no exact historical source/config runtime or empirical baseline rerun is admitted.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful within-branch free-energy improvement must be justified against source objective scale and stochastic variability, without rewarding extra capacity or model changes that invalidate the objective comparison.

uncertainty.method: Specify paired independent optimization sets for a fitting claim, and person-grouped inference for biological summaries. No independent-time-bin uncertainty is acceptable.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Independent fit set for optimization; participant for biological inference
uncertainty.rationale: Three best of 10 sets illustrate source reproducibility but do not by themselves define an admission test or practical margin.

paper_win_requires: Recover numerical source free energy, exact representation/objective normalization, original branch coverage and historical runtime recipe.
Recover independently observed original DyNeMo training-trajectory loss; do not substitute post-fit free_energy() computed from final weights.
Preserve original cohort and fixed model capacity; never average incomparable HMM, DyNeMo, burst and static objectives into a victory score.
Predeclare an effect, uncertainty and equal access/compute policy including all attempted runs.
A new held-person split, stronger young/old significance or more attractive maps cannot establish surpassing this source result.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison on the exact fixed-branch original fitting objective has been verified.

episode.improvement_loop: Recover the original per-branch fitting benchmark before candidate iteration. Any later development/final fitting sets must preserve the source protocol; newly held-out people remain a labelled extension.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate optimization method, source hyperparameters, seed/attempt policy, objective normalization and branch requirements before final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate against qualified source-author baselines per original branch with unchanged cohort and representation. No execution or substitute holdout is admitted here.
episode.baseline_policy: Source plotted free energies, rerun author values and prospective held-person likelihoods are separate; model capacity changes cannot exploit objective noncomparability.

blocking_issues: Original per-branch numeric baseline/normalization not recovered.
Native DyNeMo final training-epoch loss cannot be reconstructed from final weights; training-trajectory attestation and exact source-selection parity are missing.
Historical source revision and full six-branch preprocessing joins unresolved.
Fixed access/resource budgets, complete baseline execution, practical margin and valid optimization-set uncertainty missing.
Age-label inconsistency requires calibration repair; stronger age effects cannot be a success criterion.

legacy.notes: Preserve the six-branch programme and all original state/map/summary reconstructions as calibration. The separately authored held-person likelihood programme is explicitly an extension and cannot satisfy this contract.
